description: Angular component for customizing button styles in the Thingsboard UI, including popover interactions and style management.

classes.name: WidgetButtonCustomStyleComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing custom styles of a widget button, including popover UI for style editing.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component and updates the style preview.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, updating the style preview when appearance changes.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the value changes.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the current style value and updates the preview.

methods.name: openButtonCustomStylePopup
methods.description: Opens a popover for editing button styles.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the style model and triggers change propagation.

methods.name: updatePreviewAppearance
methods.description: Updates the style preview based on current appearance and style model.
